task: E8 second backbone(s): does the D1/D2 verdict depend on the video diffusion model?

reference_cell.why_layer_16: PREREG.md fixes layer 16 / t=600. CogVideoX-2b and the two 30-layer Wan models make layer 16 = 53.3% depth, so the cell means the same thing there. For the 40- and 42-layer models a 53.3%-depth cell (L21 / L22) is reported alongside, because layer 16 sits at 40% and 38% depth respectively.

ltx.role: third family, 32x spatial / 8x temporal VAE; D1 NOT interpretable on IntPhys 2

mochi.role: fourth family, 8x spatial / 6x temporal VAE, patch_size=2

input_geometry.note: frames and resolution are held fixed across families; the token count is NOT, because it is set by each model's patchify rule and VAE compression — see models[*].tokens

intphys2.appearance_control: self-made per-frame-constant HSV shift (hue +0.35, sat x1.4)

likephys.appearance_control: the dataset's own color_change group (50 clips)

probe.floor: definition A (seed spread), per PREREG.md D4
probe.t10_gate: effect > 2x floor AND auc_real - 0.5 > 2x floor, else NOT interpretable
probe.threads_note: The probe is NOT bit-reproducible across BLAS thread counts: LBFGS on the 300x300 Gram problem has no unique solution and the thread count changes the last iterate. E16 re-ran every cell at 4 threads and reproduced these cells bit-for-bit (12/12, diff 0.0000), which is how 4 was confirmed — it was never recorded at analysis time.

deviations.what: norm-aware initialisation: 1-D params ending in 'norm.weight' set to 1.0; floating buffers N(0,0.02)
deviations.why: wan_probe_lib zeroes every 1-D parameter, harmless on Wan because its modulation is a 2-D scale_shift_table. On CogVideoX/LTX the affine norm weight is the normaliser, so zeroing it makes norm(x)=0 and the block ignores its input. Measured: between-clip feature std exactly 0.000000 under the Wan rule.
deviations.consequence: random-DiT AUC is not numerically comparable to Wan's E7 number; ordering and verdict direction are.

deviations.what: t=298 (SNR-matched to Wan's t=600) reported alongside t=600 for VP models only
deviations.why: CogVideoX is VP/DDIM, so at t=600 the effective noise is sigma_eff=0.977 vs Wan's 0.600. t=298 has the same SNR as Wan's t=600 (0.4449 vs 0.4444). Flow-matching models have t=600 as their own SNR match, so they report a single cell.
deviations.consequence: both are reported for VP models; no cell selected after seeing a result.

deviations.what: discarded and re-extracted after the RoPE bug
deviations.why: CogVideoX-5b has use_rotary_positional_embeddings=True and builds position encoding from an externally supplied image_rotary_emb. Omitting it does not raise: the model runs position-blind, ALL layer physics AUC land at chance (0.513-0.524) while the appearance control still reaches 0.9975. Fixed in cogvideox_probe_lib._rotary_embeds(); verified by re-extraction (real AUC 0.5153 -> 0.6333 on a 217-clip subset, 0.6030 on the full set).
deviations.consequence: only the 5b cells were affected; 2b uses learned positional embeddings and Wan builds RoPE internally.

deviations.what: T5LayerNorm fallback (apex blocked) for the CogVideoX/LTX T5 embeddings
deviations.why: the installed apex lacks fused_layer_norm_cuda and transformers binds T5LayerNorm to it at import time
deviations.consequence: same normalisation; no numerical difference expected.

deviations.what: appearance AUC saturates at 1.0000 for 4 of 5 models
deviations.why: the HSV shift is a large global colour change, trivially linearly separable
deviations.consequence: reported anyway; the gap direction is unchanged by the physics AUC varying 0.55-0.97, so the D2 verdict does not rest on the saturated statistic's resolution
